item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 30/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring cold and dry weather to southern China today. With the monsoon moderating slightly midweek this week, temperatures will rise gradually and it will be cloudier over the region. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. It will be windier with a few rain patches over the region.
